and [[The Last Day Dawns]] | followed by = [[Defend Droknar's Forge (Hard mode)]] }} Find and destroy the [[Titan]]s' source of power to save [[Tyria]]. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Travel to [[Grendich Courthouse]] and speak with [[Warmaster Labofski]] to learn how you can help defend against the Titan threat. * Travel to the northwest region of [[Dragon's Gullet]] and kill the 3 Titan [[boss]]es. * Return to [[Vision of Glint]] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 50,000 Experience ==Walkthrough== The best strategy is to start out at Grendich Courthouse and travel to [[Flame Temple Corridor]], killing any bosses encountered along the way for extra [[morale]]. Alternatively, it is possible to start from [[Yak's Bend]] to have a party of 6 members, but this requires to make your way through [[Traveler's Vale]], [[Ascalon Foothills]] and [[Diessa Lowlands]]. In Flame Temple, you will encounter the Charr Lords. [[Pull]] them away from the [[patrol]]s and take them on one group at a time, then continue on to the [[Dragon's Gullet]]. Consider maxing out your morale before venturing into the lake itself. Enter the lake from the southeastern shore, northwest of the [[resurrection shrine]] that makes for a convenient restart spot should you [[wipe]] while fighting the Titan Lords. A pair of [[Hand of the Titans|Hand]] and [[Fist of the Titans|Fist]] of the Titans will [[popup|pop out of the tar]] to greet you. In the lake, you will have to deal with the constant 30% reduction in speed from the [[Tar]] [[environment effect]]. After you deal with the popups, you need to take out a number of titan patrols that circle the bosses. The patrols are made up of more Hands and Fists, and also [[Spark of the Titans|Sparks of the Titans]] and [[Risen Ashen Hulk]]s; the sparks should be your priority target as they are capable of some extremely lethal [[Fire Magic]]. The Risen Hulks are the least dangerous, and should be left for last as they split into another pair of Hand and Fist when they die. A second group of pop-up warrior titans will greet you in the southwest corner of the lake. After the lake has been cleared of patrols, it is time to complete the main objective. In the center of the lake are three Titan bosses: the Titan Lords you were sent here to dispatch. Among their ranks is a small group of Charr Lords. A good tactic is to kill the Charr Lords first then go for the Titans. ===Skill recommendations=== *A solid [[tank]] who can rush in and keep the bosses focused on him is an excellent complement to an [[Elementalist]] with [[Maelstrom]] who can render the [[Mesmer]] and [[Necromancer]] bosses useless for about 30 seconds (10 seconds of [[interrupt]]ions plus more time as their skills recharge). *Titans are very resistant to [[physical damage]], but less so to [[elemental damage]] - especially [[cold damage]]. **This can be easily accomplished with [[Icy]] weapon mods. **Alternatively, [[Winter]] will convert all elemental damage to cold damage. Because many mobs in the area use [[Greater Conflagration]], physical damage will also often be converted to cold damage through Winter. *An [[interrupt]] Mesmer can help here by shutting down the Necromancer boss and prevent him from casting [[Malaise]]. *A good way to break the anti-caster combination is to kill the Mesmer boss before the others. * Consider equipping the Ebon Vanguard Title for access to [[Rebel Yell]]'s Charr-mitigating effects. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== Titans (arranged in [[Titan#Spawning patterns|spawning pattern]] order) *{{n}} 24, 28 (26, 30) [[Risen Ashen Hulk]] **{{w}} 24, 28 (26, 30) [[Hand of the Titans]] **{{w}} 24, 28 (26, 30) [[Fist of the Titans]] *{{e}} 28 (30) [[Spark of the Titans]] [[Charr]] * {{w}} 8 (23) [[Charr Axe Fiend]] * {{w}} 24 (26) [[Charr Axe Lord]] * {{w}} 8 (23) [[Charr Blade Storm]] * {{w}} 6 (23) [[Charr Blade Warrior]] * {{r}} 8 (23) [[Charr Hunter]] * {{r}} 24 (26) [[Charr Stalker Lord]] * {{mo}} 5 (23) [[Charr Martyr]] * {{mo}} 24 (26) [[Charr Shaman Lord]] * {{n}} 8 (23) [[Charr Ashen Claw]] * {{n}} 24 (26) [[Charr Ashen Lord]] * {{me}} 8 (23) [[Charr Chaot]] * {{me}} 24 (26) [[Charr Mind Lord]] * {{e}} 24 (26) [[Charr Flame Lord]] * {{e}} 8 (23) [[Charr Flame Wielder]] ====Bosses==== Charr *{{w}} 26 [[Phlog the Indomitable]] → [[Eviscerate]] *{{r}} 26 [[Staggh the Fervid]] → [[Greater Conflagration]] *{{n}} 26 [[Lugg the Malignant]] → [[Life Transfer]] *{{me}} 26 [[Druul the Untamed]] → [[Energy Drain]] *{{e}} 26 [[Singe the Malevolent]] → [[Savannah Heat]] (requires [[Hard Mode]] and [[Nightfall]]) {{verify}} Titans *{{r}} 28 [[Gigas Expii]] → [[Melandru's Resilience]] *{{n}} 28 [[Ludo Ossidi]] → [[Wither]] *{{me}} 28 [[Mallus Funo]] → [[Panic]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Vision of Glint :''"Even with the [[Door of Komalie]] closed, the Titans still plague the people of Tyria. The source of their renewed strength is somewhere north of [[Great Northern Wall|the Wall]] in [[Ascalon]]. After the work you did protecting the cities of Tyria, I believe you are most capable of completing this task and ending the Titan threat. Warmaster Labofski has sent scouts into the northlands to identify the Titan's source of power. Travel to Grendich Courthouse and speak with him."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = The Titans must be stopped. I'll do what I can to help. | decline = I do not take this challenge lightly; I must prepare before I can help. | ask = Travel to Grendich Courthouse and speak with Warmaster Labofski. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== ;Warmaster Labofski :''"Thank you for coming. I have sent scouts out past the Flame Temple Corridor into Dragon's Gullet. Charr chieftains have been worshiping a number of burning godlike creatures and are rallying a Charr [[warband]]. My scouts are unsettled by the appearance of these creatures alone. I trust that you have confronted worse on your travels and that you are worthy enough to purge the region of this massive Charr gathering."'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Vision of Glint :''The Titans no longer threaten the good people of Tyria.''
